poll.source_locator: Sponsor's own release thread on X (@rbrtraining, Oct 8, 2026; thread head https://x.com/rbrtraining/status/2108302504446337272 '1,430-voter poll from 9/28-10/1'); WI post: 'Wisconsin sample of 662 voters: David Crowley: 49% / Tom Tiffany: 44% / Undecided: 5%'
poll.notes: Primary verified 2026-10-27 in a logged-in browser (prior run could not reach it). POPULATION NOT STATED ON PRIMARY: the sponsor says only 'voters'; 'LV' is taken from 270toWin and Wikipedia, so treat pop as unverified. State samples (MI 483 + PA 630 + WI 662 = 1,775) do not sum to the headline '1,430-voter poll'; unexplained on the primary. Full toplines/method gated behind a sign-up ('For the full Rust Belt Rising poll ... sign up'). Sponsor describes itself as helping 'Democrats be the party of working people'; Z to A founder described on firm site as a Democratic pollster.

pollster.method_locator: Firm homepage only: 'We reach voters the way they want to be reached ... via text and online.' No poll-specific methodology published.
